RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the May 9, 2002/Vaisakha 19, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; External Affairs; Labour; Parliamentary
Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning;
Road Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries;
Space; Statistics and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions—155
984
Growth of agro industries
4505. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of agro industries
in the country;
(b) the details of measures taken by
Government to improve the performance of
the agro industries;
(c) how far these measures have helped
the agro industries; and
(d) the steps stipulated in the Tenth Five
Year Plan for a healthy growth of agro
industries?
Development of coir industry in
Maharashtra
4506. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state the details
of the steps taken or proposed to be taken
by Government for promotion and
development of coir industry in the country
particularly in Maharashtra?
Infrastructure for Agro and Rural
Industries
4507. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of fruits and
vegetables that are processed in the rural
industries;
(b) the percentage of fruits and
vegetables that are wasted because of lack
of the processing facilities;
(c) the infrastructure Government have
granted to enhance the agro and rural
industries;
(d) the percentage of finance given to
agro and rural industries vis-a-vis in the
urban sector; and
(e) the number of people employed in
the agro and rural industries in the country
during the last three years State-wise and
Year-wise?

Irradiation Technology
4508. DR. KARAN SINGH:
SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU):
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Irradiation
Technology has been gainfully employed in
various developed countries, to protect the
harvest against pests, moth, moisture, fungi,
rats and rodents during storage, to enchance
the shelf life of the harvested produce;
(b) if so, whether Government have any
scheme to set up a network of Irradiation
Centres on these lines, throughout the
country, to prevent wastage of foodgrains
and other harvest during storage; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken in pursuance thereto?
Nuclear reactors
4509. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that eight nuclear
reactors are likely to be ready by 2008;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the cost involved and the
capacity of these reactors?
Expansion of Kalpakkam nuclear
power reactor
4510. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to expand the
nuclear power reactor at Kalpakkam in Tamil
Nadu with a view to increasing its
production potential;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Atomic power
4511. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the atomic power generated in April,
1997 by the atomic power plants in the
country;
(b) the atomic power being generated at
present with the generating capacity added
during the last five years;
(c) the plans to increase this power
generation during next five years; and
(d) the other details in this regard?
Power generated by atomic power
stations
4512. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the power generated through the
atomic power stations during the last five
years, year-wise;
(b) whether Government have identified
global markets to export nuclear power
reactors or components; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Telephone connections in Delhi
4513. DR. KARAN SINGH:
SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU):
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether despite written and oral
assurances given to telephone users to the
effect that all telephone connections in the
Union Territory of Delhi under MTNL
would be provided within six months from
the date of application with due security
asking the applicants to make a complaint,

(b) if so, the number of applicants in
